entities.name: Alphabet – Google
entities.brief: Parent company of Google, reports strong Q2 results.
entities.description: Alphabet is the parent of Google, exhibiting robust Q2 2025 growth in search, YouTube, and cloud businesses.

entities.name: Alphabet – YouTube
entities.brief: Google's video platform, strong Q2 ad revenue.
entities.description: YouTube, a subsidiary of Alphabet, continues to deliver high ad revenue and strong growth in Shorts and traditional ads.

entities.name: Alphabet – Cloud
entities.brief: Alphabet's cloud computing business.
entities.description: Alphabet's Cloud division showed accelerated revenue and margin growth in Q2 2025, with several large deals closed.

entities.name: Alphabet – Gemini App
entities.brief: AI app with accelerating user growth.
entities.description: Google's Gemini app exceeded 450 million MAUs, growing by 50 million in two months, highlighting strong user adoption.

entities.name: Alphabet – 2Q 2025 Earnings Release
entities.brief: Q2 2025 financial results announcement.
entities.description: Alphabet reported its Q2 2025 earnings, showing growth across core segments despite competitive and regulatory risks.

entities.name: Alphabet – Search Revenue 2Q 2025
entities.brief: Search revenue YoY growth in Q2.
entities.description: Search revenue grew 12% YoY in Q2 2025, outperforming Street's estimate of 9%.

entities.name: Alphabet – YouTube Revenue 2Q 2025
entities.brief: YouTube revenue YoY growth in Q2.
entities.description: YouTube revenues rose 13% YoY in Q2 2025, ahead of Street's 11% estimate, with 3pts acceleration quarter-over-quarter.

entities.name: Alphabet – Cloud Revenue 2Q 2025
entities.brief: Cloud revenue YoY growth in Q2.
entities.description: Cloud revenue grew 32% YoY, outpacing Street's 27% estimate and accelerating from previous quarter.

entities.name: Alphabet – GAAP EPS Growth 2Q 2025
entities.brief: GAAP EPS YoY percentage increase.
entities.description: Alphabet's GAAP EPS grew by 22% YoY in Q2 2025, reflecting strong profitability.

entities.name: Alphabet – Core Google Operating Margin 2Q 2025
entities.brief: Core Google operating margin in Q2.
entities.description: Core Google operating margin was reported as 38.3% in Q2 2025, down 17bps YoY.

entities.name: Alphabet – Cloud Margin 2Q 2025
entities.brief: Cloud margin expansion in Q2.
entities.description: Cloud margin improved by 942bps YoY to 20.7% in Q2 2025.

entities.name: Alphabet – Total Headcount 2Q 2025
entities.brief: Total Alphabet staff count during Q2.
entities.description: Alphabet's headcount at end Q2 was 187,100, up 4% YoY and 1% QoQ.

entities.name: Alphabet – Stock Buybacks 2Q 2025
entities.brief: Value of stock repurchases in Q2.
entities.description: Alphabet repurchased $13.6bn of stock in Q2 2025, down from $15.1bn in Q1, with $59.5bn over the trailing twelve months.

entities.name: Alphabet – Cash Dividend 2Q 2025
entities.brief: Dividend per share in Q2.
entities.description: Alphabet's cash dividend was unchanged at $0.21 per share in Q2 2025.

entities.name: Alphabet – Paid Click Growth 2Q 2025
entities.brief: Paid ad click YoY growth in Q2.
entities.description: Paid click growth accelerated to 4% YoY in Q2, approaching the previous year's 5%.

entities.name: Alphabet – Al Overviews Queries Growth
entities.brief: Increase in queries driven by AI Overviews.
entities.description: AI Overviews are driving over 10% more queries globally for eligible query types.

entities.name: Alphabet – Multimodal Search Growth
entities.brief: Growth in multimodal search usage.
entities.description: Multimodal search is seeing strong growth, particularly with Lens, Circle to Search, and AI Overviews.

entities.name: Alphabet – Advertiser Conversions via Al Max
entities.brief: Conversion uplift for advertisers using AI Max.
entities.description: Advertisers using AI Max in search campaigns achieve 14% more conversions on average.

entities.name: Alphabet – Advertiser Conversions via Smart Bidding
entities.brief: Conversion uplift for advertisers using Smart Bidding.
entities.description: Smart Bidding Exploration tools yield a 19% increase in conversions for advertisers on average.

entities.name: Alphabet – YouTube Shorts Ad Revenue Parity
entities.brief: US YouTube Shorts ad revenue per hour matches in-stream.
entities.description: In the US, YouTube Shorts now deliver the same ad revenue per hour as traditional in-stream ads.

entities.name: Alphabet – Cloud Large Deals 2Q 2025
entities.brief: Year-over-year change in >$250mn cloud deals.
entities.description: Number of cloud deals exceeding $250mn doubled YoY in Q2 2025.

Improved margin impacts Cloud business performance.
Strong Gemini user growth enhances Google’s AI user base.
Higher paid clicks drive search revenue.
Al Overviews increase query volume for eligible types.
Multimodal search contributes to overall search revenue.

relationships.source: Alphabet – Advertiser Conversions via Al Max
relationships.description: AI Max increases search ad conversions by 14%.

relationships.source: Alphabet – Advertiser Conversions via Smart Bidding
relationships.description: Smart Bidding increases search ad conversions by 19%.

relationships.source: Alphabet – YouTube Shorts Ad Revenue Parity
relationships.description: Shorts ad revenue is now on par with in-stream ads.
Buybacks support stock performance and return capital.
Doubling of large cloud deals drives overall cloud revenue.
